use_for: Official US AQI categories: Good, Moderate, Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, Unhealthy, Very Unhealthy, Hazardous. keywords: air quality index aqi epa colors pm2.5 pm10 ozone good moderate unhealthy hazardous standard official category station

keywords: air quality index aqi epa colorvision assist colorblind cvd alternative colors accessible

name: US Drought Monitor D0-D4
use_for: D0 abnormally dry to D4 exceptional drought. Use black text on D0-D2 and white text on D3-D4 per NDMC. Use NDMC hex, not older drought.gov values.
keywords: us drought monitor usdm d0 d1 d2 d3 d4 drought severity classes ndmc

name: ESA WorldCover v200 land cover (11 classes)
use_for: Official class colors in code order: Tree cover 10, Shrubland 20, Grassland 30, Cropland 40, Built-up 50, Bare/sparse 60, Snow and ice 70, Permanent water 80, Herbaceous wetland 90, Mangroves 95, Moss and lichen 100. Eleven classes, not ten; not CVD-safe, so label directly.
keywords: esa worldcover land cover lulc classes tree cropland built-up water mangrove wetland landcover standard

name: NDVI ramp (Sentinel Hub script)
use_for: Fixed-range NDVI: never stretch per image (E03). 21 stops at values -0.5, -0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.025, 0.05, 0.075, 0.1, 0.125, 0.15, 0.175, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.45, 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 1. Brown to green, not CVD-safe. Script is sourced; that EO Browser uses this exact ramp is unconfirmed.
keywords: ndvi vegetation index crop health greenness ramp sentinel-2 fixed range

name: NDWI ramp (Sentinel Hub script)
use_for: Fixed-range NDWI = (B03-B08)/(B03+B08), water positive. Stops at -0.8, 0, 0.8: green to white to blue. Not CVD-safe. EO Browser equivalence unconfirmed.
keywords: ndwi water index mcfeeters sentinel-2 open water diverging green blue fixed range

name: EDO Combined Drought Indicator classes
use_for: Seven CDI classes: no drought, Watch, Warning, Alert, Recovery, temporary soil-moisture recovery, temporary vegetation recovery. Factsheet names classes and says yellow/orange/red for Watch/Warning/Alert; colors here are Claude-chosen, not official. Check: min contrast 1.6:1 vs #F5F5F3, 4.9:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 16 normal, 12 deuteranopia, 15 protanopia. Fill ramp: light or near-zero stops fall under 3:1 by design, so add an outline or halo (A06, A07).
keywords: copernicus edo cdi combined drought indicator watch warning alert recovery drought classes europe

name: InSAR / ground-motion velocity (diverging)
use_for: Line-of-sight or vertical velocity in mm/yr, symmetric clamp around 0 (e.g. -10..+10 or EGMS -20..+20), stable band near 0. Red-yellow-blue RdYlBu-style, no green, instead of a rainbow. Hex Claude-chosen; EGMS publishes no hex. Check: min contrast 1.0:1 vs #F5F5F3, 1.7:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 25 normal, 23 deuteranopia, 20 protanopia. Fill ramp: light or near-zero stops fall under 3:1 by design, so add an outline or halo (A06, A07).
keywords: insar velocity diverging egms ground motion deformation subsidence uplift mm/yr centered zero symmetric landslide los

name: dNBR burn severity (7 classes)
use_for: USGS FireMon thresholds (via university copy; analyst-dependent): < -0.25 high regrowth, -0.25..-0.1 low regrowth, -0.1..0.1 unburned, 0.1..0.27 low, 0.27..0.44 moderate-low, 0.44..0.66 moderate-high, > 0.66 high. Colors Claude-chosen. Check: min contrast 1.1:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.1:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 22 normal, 19 deuteranopia, 18 protanopia. Fill ramp: light or near-zero stops fall under 3:1 by design, so add an outline or halo (A06, A07).
keywords: dnbr burn severity nbr fire burned area unburned regrowth moderate high usgs mtbs

name: Active fire hotspot age
use_for: Hotspot age bins: <6 h, 6-24 h, 24-48 h, >48 h. Most recent is red; older fades to grey. Always show age in the legend text. Check: min contrast 3.2:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.1:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 25 normal, 14 deuteranopia, 18 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: fire age hotspot active fire firms viirs modis recent hours old time since detection

name: Flood vs permanent water vs no-data
use_for: Observed flood (strong blue), permanent/reference water (teal), no-data or exclusion mask (grey, draw with hatch). Never use the same blue for flood and permanent water, never show no-data as clean. Reference water is a mid teal because pale blue fails 3:1 contrast. Check: min contrast 3.1:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.2:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 34 normal, 20 deuteranopia, 18 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: flood extent observed permanent water reference water no-data exclusion mask hatch hatched sar radar shadow

name: Damage grading
use_for: Destroyed, damaged, possibly damaged, no visible damage. Colors follow EMS-style red/orange/yellow semantics but are Claude-chosen; blue marks no visible damage rather than green. Check: min contrast 3.1:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.1:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 29 normal, 15 deuteranopia, 19 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: damage grading destroyed damaged possibly damaged building assessment disaster response ems earthquake

name: Generic 5-level severity
use_for: Info, Low, Medium, High, Critical. Use with an icon or label, never color alone (A07). Stops are hue-separated, not an ordered lightness ramp; Critical is magenta-pink for CVD separation from orange. Check: min contrast 3.3:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.2:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 27 normal, 11 deuteranopia, 10 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: severity levels info low medium high critical alert status generic five level priority

name: Vessel types and unmatched detection
use_for: Cargo, tanker, passenger, fishing, tug/special, other/unknown. Reserve a separate high-contrast magenta marker for unmatched SAR detections (dark vessels), and do not reuse it here. Combine with icon shapes. Check: min contrast 3.1:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.1:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 35 normal, 14 deuteranopia, 15 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: vessel types ais ship cargo tanker passenger fishing tug unknown maritime qualitative marker

name: Detection confidence levels
use_for: Low, medium, high confidence for ML detections, alerts or oil-slick classes. Hue-separated (blue, violet, magenta) and paired with an opacity or outline-weight change. Check: min contrast 3.6:1 vs #F5F5F3, 3.1:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 57 normal, 29 deuteranopia, 31 protanopia. Symbol colors; every stop >=3:1 on both basemaps. Under CVD pair with icon, label or pattern (A07).
keywords: detection confidence level low medium high highest ai model score alert threshold

name: Standard zoning land-use colors
use_for: Residential yellow, commercial red, industrial purple, green space green, mixed-use orange, institutional blue. Follows common planning convention (APA-style); hex Claude-chosen, no single standard hex exists. Use 60-70 percent opacity over a muted basemap. Check: min contrast 1.4:1 vs #F5F5F3, 5.5:1 vs #1E1E1E (dark set); min CIELAB dE between stops 31 normal, 5 deuteranopia, 9 protanopia. Fill ramp: light or near-zero stops fall under 3:1 by design, so add an outline or halo (A06, A07).
keywords: zoning land use standard colors residential commercial industrial green space mixed use planning parcel
